filters.name: Optional filters — leave blank for default behaviour
filters.description: All four fields below are optional. Leave them all blank to see the next trip from now, every day. Fill them in to pin the sensor to specific weekdays, a time of day, a date, or a margin around a time.

data.filter_window_minutes: Margin around the chosen time (± minutes)

data_description.filter_days: Pick one or more weekdays. The sensor rolls forward to the next selected day once today's selection is in the past. Leave empty to allow every day.
data_description.filter_time: Anchor moment for the trip search. Combined with the margin slider below. Leave empty to use the current time.
data_description.filter_window_minutes: How many minutes before and after the chosen time to keep in the result. 0 means: only show trips at or after the anchor.
data_description.filter_date: Pin the route to one specific date. Day-of-week and rolling behaviour are skipped — the sensor empties once that date plus its margin has passed.

init.title: NS Reisadvies options
init.description: These settings apply to every route under this integration.

data_description.api_key: Your NS API subscription key. Replace if it has been rotated.
data_description.scan_interval_minuten: How often the integration polls the NS API. Allowed range: 1 to 60.
data_description.fav_hours: How long to keep a pinned favourite before it is removed automatically. Set to 0 to disable expiry.
data_description.fetch_composition: Adds an extra NS API call per unique train per refresh to retrieve the actual carriage composition (number of carriages, rolling-stock type, image). Off by default to save API quota.
data_description.live_train_map: Adds a small map icon under the departure platform of each leg. Tapping it opens a map showing the route, stops, and the live train position. The position is only fetched while the map is open.
data_description.live_map_refresh_seconds: How often to refresh the train's GPS position while the live map is open. Faster means smoother movement but slightly more network traffic. Range: 5 to 60 seconds.
data_description.first_weekday: Which weekday should appear at the top of the day-picker on the per-route filter form. Display only — does not change anything else.
